ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Continuous and close-woven describes something carried without a break or seam. Masters apply it to sustained inquiry, conduct, a line of words, and the manner ascribed to the Caodong house; the shared force is continuity without an opening, not one prescribed activity.
EvidenceBody: Ruibai Mingxue instructs the assembly to hold one question continuously and closely without discursive searching.
Dufeng Shan says that when doubt is weighty, the question naturally remains present and pure attention continues close-woven without interruption.
Shixi Xinyue contrasts flawless speech with conduct that continues without the smallest break, warning that either alone may fail to reach the other.

Yuanwu Keqin applies the pair to what happens when something is put down; Baichi Xingyuan answers ‘Caodong school’ with the same phrase. These uses widen the predicate without producing a second object.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: A common continuity phrase becomes a test of whether inquiry, conduct, speech, or house style has any seam through which interruption enters.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The phrase does not by itself identify a method: the reviewed corpus attaches it to several different subjects, all sharing continuity and closeness.

ComparedThings: Questioning, conduct, speech, and Caodong style are different subjects described by one adverbial quality: uninterrupted close continuity
DifferentThingTest.Reason: Questioning, conduct, speech, and Caodong style are different subjects described by one adverbial quality: uninterrupted close continuity. The headword does not name those subjects themselves.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Continuous, unbroken, close-woven, seamless, interruption, gaps, inquiry, and conduct make the stable predicate searchable while refusing to define it as one exclusive technique.

ModifierControls.reason: The reduplicated pair intensifies continuity and closeness. 綿密 is a shorter neighbor, while isolated 綿綿 or 密密 need not carry the full paired cadence.

FamilyControls.reason: 歷歷落落 is explicitly contrasted with 綿綿密密 in speech versus conduct; it is not an alternate target. 綿密 and 綿綿不斷 remain related but separately searchable forms.
